landing.headline: Work you can check before you pay for it.
landing.lede: Agents handle routine operations such as order reconciliation and refund triage. When a call needs judgement, a vetted reviewer makes it. An independent check verifies the result, and nothing is paid until you accept it.

connections.title: Connections
connections.lede: Connect an app once. Each pack you add then gets only the access you grant it. The app's own sign-in permissions and the grants below are separate, and you can revoke either one.

studio.noPacks: No packs yet. A pack is a workflow: its steps, who reviews and approves, and what it delivers.
studio.liveOnlyTitle: The Studio is part of the live workspace
studio.liveOnlyBody: The demo workspace shows finished packs only. Sign in to your own workspace to build agents and packs.
studio.buildersOnly: Only owners and admins can build agents and packs.

studioAgents.title: Agents
studioAgents.lede: Agents your company built. Each one reads from your apps and prepares work for a pack's steps.
studioAgents.newLede: Describe what the agent does and which apps it reads. Steps that change data belong in a pack, after an approval.
studioAgents.editLede: Saving makes a new version and rebuilds the packs that use it. Runs already started keep the version they started with.
studioAgents.viewLede: An agent your company built. Only an owner or admin can change it.
studioAgents.emptyMember: No agents yet. An owner or admin can build one.
studioAgents.notYours: This agent is not one of yours.
studioAgents.name: Name
studioAgents.maxTurnsHelp: How many times the agent may use a tool before it answers, from 1 to 20. The usual setting is {n}.
studioAgents.toolsHelp: Agents only read. Steps that change data in an app go in a pack, after an approval.
studioAgents.toolGone: No longer available in your apps. Untick it to remove it.
studioAgents.noSkills: No skills yet. A skill is a short how-to the agent follows, such as how to find open invoices.
studioAgents.notAllowed: Only an owner or admin can build agents. Ask one of them to save it.
studioAgents.conflictBody: Version {n} is now the latest. Loading it replaces any unsaved changes here.
studioAgents.conflictSaved: Someone saved a newer version since you opened this one. Loading it replaces any unsaved changes here.
studioAgents.reloadFailed: The latest version could not be loaded
studioAgents.problems: {n, plural, one {# problem to fix} other {# problems to fix}}
studioAgents.packIssue: {name} would not work with this agent
studioAgents.unused: Not used by a pack yet

refusal.self: A step cannot lead to itself.
refusal.intoStart: Nothing leads back to the start. Start a new run instead.
refusal.unknownOutcome: Connect from one of the step's outcomes, on its right side.
refusal.writeNeedsApproval: A step that changes data in an app must follow an approval's “granted” outcome.

studioCanvas.nodeHelp: Press Enter or Space to select the step and open its settings. Use the arrow keys to move it.
studioCanvas.nodeHelpReadOnly: Press Enter or Space to select the step and see its settings.
studioCanvas.edgeHelp: An outcome leading to the next step.

studioCel.isCel: An expression: it is worked out when the step runs.
studioCel.isText: Plain text. Start with = to write an expression, or pick a field.
studioCel.isCondition: A condition in CEL, such as size(nodes.plan.output.messages) == 0.

studioFields.nothingSelected: Choose a step on the canvas or in the step list to change its settings.
studioFields.stepNameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, such as ledger_check. Other steps use it to read this step's result.

rename.badId: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (40 at most).
rename.taken: Another step already has that name.

studioFields.chooseToolFirst: Choose an app tool first; its fields appear here.
studioFields.unknownSettingHelp: The tool does not have this setting, so a run would refuse it. Remove it.
studioFields.extraHelp: Settings beyond the ones named above. This tool accepts them.
studioFields.nameTaken: Another value already has that name.
studioFields.wholeExpression: An expression stands for the whole value. Clear it to set the fields one by one.
studioFields.argsExpressionHelp: The tool's settings must be named one by one; an expression for all of them cannot be saved. Clear it, then set each one.
studioFields.jsonHelp: An expression starting with =, or JSON. Read when you leave the field.

jsonInvalid.array: Enter a JSON list, or an expression starting with =.
jsonInvalid.object: Enter a JSON object, or an expression starting with =.

help.query: Words that find the right notes in the space.
help.forEach: Optional. A list to run the tool once per item; the settings below can read item.
help.task: What this step asks the agent to do, in plain words.
help.inputs: Each named value is given to the agent. Use an expression to pass an earlier step's result.
help.show: The data a reviewer works from, usually an earlier step's result.
help.timeout: After this long the step takes its timeout outcome. In seconds, from 1 to 172800 (two days).
help.summary: One line the approver sees, such as how many drafts will be saved.
help.checks: Each check is an expression that must be true for the step to pass.
help.deliverable: Optional. The result the business sees when the run completes.

rules.empty: A decision asks one question and picks a route by its rules. Start from an example, then change it.
rules.starterQuestion: Does this need a person to look at it?
rules.starterYes: Something needs a closer look, so a person checks it.
rules.starterNo: Nothing needs a closer look, so the run goes on.
rules.question: Question
rules.routeHelp: An outcome on the canvas: lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Applied when you leave the field.
rules.sharedRoute: Another rule of this decision leads to this route too.

studioPalette.help: Drag a step onto the canvas, or choose it to add it beside the selected step.
studioPalette.blocked: Packs cannot use tools that delete records or move money.
studioPalette.unlinked: The step that followed is no longer connected

cut.needsRoutes: Add the decision's rules, then choose where each goes.

say.trigger: The run starts with the pack's input.
say.memoryBlank: Recalls notes from memory. Choose a space.
say.connectorBlank: Uses an app. Choose a tool.
say.agentBlank: An agent prepares the work. Choose one.
say.decisionBlank: Decides where the run goes. Add its rules.
say.reviewBlank: A person reviews the work. Give it a title.
say.approvalBlank: Your team approves the next step. Give it a title.
say.verification: Checks the result before going on.

studioPacks.lede: Packs your company built. Each one appears in your marketplace under Built by your team.
studioPacks.newLede: Lay out the steps on the canvas or in the step list. Save to make version 1; only your company sees it.
studioPacks.editLede: Saving makes a new version. Runs already started keep the version they started with.
studioPacks.viewLede: A pack your company built. Only an owner or admin can change it.
studioPacks.empty: No packs yet. Start from a small example and change it step by step.
studioPacks.emptyMember: No packs yet. An owner or admin can build one.
studioPacks.notYours: This pack is not one of yours.
studioPacks.name: Name

studioEditor.savedVersion: Version {n} is saved. Find it in your marketplace under Built by your team.
studioEditor.fixFirst: Fix the problems below the steps first. The server would refuse the pack as it is.
studioEditor.seeProblems: See the problems below the steps.
studioEditor.conflictBody: Version {n} is now the latest. Loading it replaces any unsaved changes here.
studioEditor.conflictSaved: Someone saved a newer version since you opened this one. Loading it replaces any unsaved changes here.
studioEditor.reloadFailed: The latest version could not be loaded
studioEditor.runsInProgress: The pack cannot be renamed yet
studioEditor.runsInProgressBody: Runs of this pack are in progress, and a rename would change what they are allowed to do. Wait for them to finish, or keep the current name.
studioEditor.checkOkBody: The server accepts this pack as it is.
studioEditor.checkError: The pack could not be checked
studioEditor.smallScreen: Easier on a larger screen. The canvas is left out here: choose a step in the list to change its settings, and connect steps under Where each outcome goes.
studioEditor.name: Name
studioEditor.budget: Most a run may spend on agents (USD)
studioEditor.humanBudget: Most a run may pay reviewers (USD)
studioEditor.budgetHelp: Spend counts toward your monthly cap.
studioEditor.inputFieldsHelp: What someone fills in to start a run. Steps read each field as input.field_name.

starter.name: New workflow pack
starter.outcome: Each request gets a checked answer.
starter.description: A person reviews each request and records the answer. Add agents, app steps and approvals to do more of the work.
starter.reviewInstructions: Read the request and record your answer.

studioIssues.title: {n, plural, =0 {Problems} one {# problem} other {# problems}}
studioIssues.noStart: The pack needs a start step.
studioIssues.manyStarts: A pack has one start step. Remove the others.
studioIssues.unrouted: The {outcome} outcome goes nowhere. Connect it to the next step.
studioIssues.unreachable: No path from the start reaches this step.
studioIssues.neverCompletes: No path ends in a completed end step.
studioIssues.writeWithoutApproval: This step changes data in an app, so it must come right after an approval's granted outcome.
studioIssues.blockedTool: Packs cannot use tools that delete records or move money.
studioIssues.missingArg: The tool's {arg} setting is required. Set it.
studioIssues.unknownArg: The tool has no {arg} setting. Remove it.
studioIssues.argsExpression: The tool's settings must be named values, one per setting, not a single expression. Set each one.
studioIssues.noRules: Add the rules this decision decides with.
studioIssues.missingRules: Finish the decision: a question, and for each rule a condition, a route name and an explanation.
studioIssues.missingCheck: Add a check, or a schema to check against.
studioIssues.badId: Step names use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
studioIssues.tooFewSteps: A pack needs at least two steps: the start and an end.
studioIssues.tooManySteps: A pack can have at most 60 steps. Remove some.
studioIssues.badFieldName: Field {n}: names use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

studioYaml.title: workflow.yaml
studioYaml.lede: The pack's steps as a workflow definition file, the same format the platform's own packs use.
studioYaml.exportFailed: The workflow.yaml could not be loaded
studioYaml.savedOnly: This is the saved version. Save to include your latest changes.
studioYaml.saveFirst: Save the pack first; then its workflow.yaml appears here.
studioYaml.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
studioYaml.importWarn: Every step in this draft is replaced by the file's steps. Undo brings the old ones back.
studioYaml.importButton: Replace the draft with this file
studioYaml.importedBody: {n, plural, one {# step is} other {# steps are}} in the editor.
studioYaml.importFailed: The YAML could not be imported
studioYaml.importIssues: {n, plural, one {# step could not be read} other {# steps could not be read}}
studioYaml.noStart: The file has no start step, so nothing was imported.

studioTest.title: Test in sandbox
studioTest.lede: Runs the saved version on sandbox data. Agent spend counts toward your monthly cap.
studioTest.saveFirst: Save the pack to test it.
studioTest.saveChangesFirst: Save your changes to test them.
studioTest.inputHelp: The pack's start form, filled in as someone starting a real run would. The run reads it as its input.
studioTest.budgetHelp: Optional. Leave it empty to use the pack's own budget of {amount} USD.
studioTest.failed: The test run did not start
studioTest.budgetRequired: Enter a budget for this test. The pack sets no maximum of its own.
studioTest.budgetTooHigh: The budget is above the pack's maximum. Lower it.
studioTest.invalidInput: {n, plural, one {The start form has a problem. Fix it and try again.} other {The start form has problems. Fix them and try again.}}
studioTest.sandboxUnavailable: This deployment does not use the platform's sandbox connectors, so test runs cannot start here.
studioTest.spendCap: Your workspace has reached its monthly spend cap. Test runs count toward it.
